Photographed from a fairly high overhead angle, roughly top-down.

STEP 2 - Ruler: A white square-ish bowl/plate about 26 cm across at its widest visible edge. Radius 13 cm, area ≈ 3.14 x 13² ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: (a) roasted meat pieces, (b) cooked dark leafy greens, (c) small dark pieces (beetroot or similar) mixed with the greens.

STEP 4 - Area: Meat ~28% of vessel (about 150 cm²). Leafy greens ~9% (about 48 cm²). Dark pieces ~2% (about 10 cm²). Total food ≈ 39% of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume: Meat: 150 cm² x 2.0 cm pile ≈ 300 ml. Greens: 48 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 72 ml. Dark pieces: 10 cm² x 1 cm ≈ 10 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Meat 300 ml x 0.95 ≈ 285 g. Greens 72 ml x 0.15 ≈ 11 g. Dark pieces 10 ml x 0.6 ≈ 6 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Roasted meat (pork/lamb, cooked) ~250 kcal/100 g → 285 g ≈ 713 kcal. Cooked leafy greens ~25 kcal/100 g → 11 g ≈ 3 kcal. Beetroot ~43 kcal/100 g → 6 g ≈ 3 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 300 g total with roughly 720 kcal. A generous meat portion with a small vegetable garnish is plausible for a plated restaurant-style main. The meat pile estimate is the largest uncertainty; the total is plausibly within ±30%.
